title: Meet Our Robots: Seven Seasons of Ingenuity | Highlander Robotics
description: Explore every Team 8033 robot from Nessie to Wisp, with season highlights and a closer look at each design.
body:
Meet Our Robots

Explore seven seasons of engineering, creativity, and competition—from our first build to our latest robot.

2026 · Rebuilt

Wisp

A compact swerve robot with a spindexer, rotating turret, adjustable shooter, and tube-in-tube climber. Explore the systems that took Wisp to the NorCal District Championship.

Meet Wisp →

2025 · Reefscape

Kelpie

Built around a swerve drivetrain, elevator, arm, and end effector, Kelpie earned finalist finishes at the San Francisco and East Bay regionals.

Meet Kelpie →

2024 · Crescendo

Banshee

A swerve-driven robot with an elevator, shooter, and climber. Banshee carried the team to the Milstein Division finals at the World Championship in Houston.

Meet Banshee →

2023 · Charged Up

Paddo

Our 2023 World Championship robot combines a swerve drivetrain, cascading elevator, roller grabber, and cube intake to handle cones and cubes.

Meet Paddo →

2022 · Rapid React

Selkie

A compact square swerve drivetrain, integrated router and shooter, over-bumper intake, and two-stage climber make up our 2022 robot.

Meet Selkie →

2021 · Infinite Recharge

Whirlpool

Our second robot introduced swerve drive, a hood-style shooter, a cable-track climber, and a revolving mechanism that could carry five balls.

Meet Whirlpool →

2020 · Infinite Recharge

Nessie

Meet the robot that started it all: a low-goal shooter, extending intake, and color-sensing control panel built by Team 8033’s founders.

Meet Nessie →
